layers.name: system
layers.content:
# System defaults
HOSTNAME=worker-node-03
TZ=UTC
LANG=en_US.UTF-8
PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
LIB_PATH=/usr/lib
CONFIG_DIR=/etc/myapp
DATA_DIR=${CONFIG_DIR}/data
LOG_DIR=${DATA_DIR}/logs
FLAG_VALUE=${QUOTED_PREFIX}--verbose

layers.name: application
layers.content:
# Application config
APP_VERSION=3.2.1
APP_HOME=/opt/myapp
CONFIG_DIR=/opt/myapp/conf
WORKER_COUNT=4
BINDING=""0.0.0.0:9090""
CERT_SUBJECT=""CN=worker-03.prod""
STARTUP_MSG='Starting application.
Loading configuration.
Ready to serve.'
QUOTED_PREFIX=""""

layers.name: overrides
layers.content:
# Same priority as system - later wins
HOSTNAME=worker-node-03-override
TZ=America/New_York
